name: No backdrop
desc: The glass, the water and whatever the lights are doing. Nothing behind it.

name: Standing water
desc: Whatever the conservatory was shipped with. Dark, deep and specific to nowhere.

name: Shelf reef
desc: A shelf of something coral-coloured, painted from a description rather than from life.

name: Sounding hull
desc: The stern of something that went down a long way from any sea. Nobody asks which.

name: Kelp gallery
desc: Columns of weed going up further than the tank is tall, which the tank does not explain.

name: The trench
desc: A cut in the floor with the light stopping partway down it. Popular with people who have never been down one.

name: Lamp line
desc: A row of breach lamps burning in open water, seen from below. A working scene, sold as a view.

name: Open rupture
desc: A hole with the wrong stars through it. Conservatories that hang this one get letters about it.

name: The abyss
desc: Nothing, painted accurately. There is a great deal of it and it is not black.
